capabilities: Open an animated star-system view of the vault
Navigate folders by clicking planets and notes by clicking moons
Customize per-folder color, icon, orbit and visibility
Adjust orbit, motion, file and appearance settings
Pan and zoom the system with the mouse
disambiguation: Not a note-content graph like Graph view; it visualizes and navigates the folder structure only.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a privacy section stating it only reads folder and file structure, not note contents.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and graph view don't offer a spatial, animated way to browse and navigate folder hierarchy with notes around each folder.
summary: Visualization view that renders the vault as an animated star system where subfolders orbit the current folder as planets and notes circle them as moons.
